        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.mixture import GaussianMixture\n",
        "\n",
        "# Generate sample dataset\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "X1 = np.random.normal(5, 1, 100)\n",
        "X2 = np.random.normal(10, 1, 100)\n",
        "\n",
        "X = np.concatenate([X1, X2]).reshape(-1, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create Gaussian Mixture Model\n",
        "model = GaussianMixture(n_components=2, random_state=42)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train using EM algorithm\n",
        "model.fit(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predict clusters\n",
        "labels = model.predict(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display results\n",
        "print(\"Cluster Means:\")\n",
        "print(model.means_)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nCluster Predictions:\")\n",
        "print(labels)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nModel Converged:\", model.converged_)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot clusters\n",
        "plt.scatter(X, np.zeros(len(X)), c=labels)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Expectation Maximization Algorithm\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Data Values\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Clusters\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ]
    }
  ]
